edges.reason: onlyStakingContract requires msg.sender == stakingContract, gating rebase with caller identity.
stakingContract state variable is the reference value compared against msg.sender in the modifier.
rebase is only reachable through the onlyStakingContract guard.
onlyManager requires _owner == msg.sender, gating privileged management calls.
_owner is the trusted value compared against msg.sender inside onlyManager.
setIndex is protected by the onlyManager modifier.
pushManagement is protected by the onlyManager modifier.
initialize requires msg.sender == initializer, a one-shot authorization.
initializer state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorize initialize.
initialize writes the stakingContract address.
stakingContract_ parameter is consumed by initialize.
initialize assigns TOTAL_GONS to _gonBalances at the staking contract key derived from stakingContract_.
initialize mutates the _gonBalances mapping.
initialize resets initializer to address(0), enforcing single-use initialization.
profit_ feeds the SafeMath mul/div supply computation in rebase.
epoch_ is carried through the rebase accounting and propagated to _storeRebase.
rebase adds rebaseAmount to _totalSupply with SafeMath.add and clamps at MAX_SUPPLY.
rebase recomputes _gonsPerFragment = TOTAL_GONS / _totalSupply.
rebase invokes the internal _storeRebase to persist the round.
block.timestamp is emitted in the LogSupply event inside rebase, creating timestamp dependence.
block.timestamp is emitted in LogSupply from _storeRebase, creating timestamp dependence.
previousCirculating_ is the divisor in the rebase percent computation inside _storeRebase.
profit_ is multiplied by 1e18 and divided by previousCirculating_ inside _storeRebase.
epoch_ is stored into the pushed Rebase struct.
_storeRebase pushes a new Rebase entry into the rebases array.
_storeRebase calls circulatingSupply() for totalStakedAfter.
_INDEX parameter is converted and written by setIndex.
setIndex writes INDEX once, permanently setting the staking index.
setIndex calls gonsForBalance to convert the index.
who parameter indexes the _gonBalances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads _gonBalances[who].
balanceOf divides the gon balance by _gonsPerFragment.
amount parameter is multiplied by _gonsPerFragment in gonsForBalance.
gonsForBalance reads _gonsPerFragment.
gons parameter is divided by _gonsPerFragment in balanceForGons.
balanceForGons reads _gonsPerFragment.
circulatingSupply subtracts the staking balance from _totalSupply with SafeMath.sub.
circulatingSupply calls balanceOf(stakingContract).
circulatingSupply uses the stakingContract address as the excluded holder.
index() reads the INDEX state variable.
index() calls balanceForGons on INDEX.
to parameter receives the credited gon balance in transfer.
value parameter is converted to gonValue in transfer.
msg.sender is the debited party in transfer.
transfer mutates _gonBalances for both sender and recipient.
transfer multiplies value by _gonsPerFragment.
gonValue local holds the computed gon amount used in transfer.
from parameter is debited in transferFrom.
to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
value parameter bounds the allowance and gon movement in transferFrom.
msg.sender allowance is decremented and spent in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes _allowedValue[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom moves gon balances in _gonBalances.
transferFrom calls gonsForBalance(value).
spender parameter receives the allowance in approve.
value parameter is the allowance amount written in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
approve writes _allowedValue[msg.sender][spender].
spender parameter identifies the allowance slot in increaseAllowance.
addedValue is added to the current allowance with SafeMath.add.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in increaseAllowance.
increaseAllowance writes _allowedValue[msg.sender][spender].
spender parameter identifies the allowance slot in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the cached allowance with SafeMath.sub.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in decreaseAllowance.
decreaseAllowance writes _allowedValue[msg.sender][spender].
oldValue local caches the previous allowance before the branch in decreaseAllowance.
owner parameter is hashed and compared against the recovered signer in permit.
spender parameter is bound into the permit hash and later approved.
amount parameter is bound into the permit hash and becomes the allowance.
deadline parameter is bound into the permit hash and checked against the timestamp.
v signature component is attacker-supplied and passed to ecrecover.
r signature component is attacker-supplied and passed to ecrecover.
s signature component is attacker-supplied and passed to ecrecover.
block.timestamp is compared to the user-supplied deadline in permit, a timestamp dependency.
permit invokes ecrecover to authorize the allowance change from a signature.
signer local is produced by ecrecover inside permit.
recovered signer must be non-zero and equal owner to pass the permit check.
hashStruct local aggregates the permit parameters and owner nonce.
permit calls _approve after the signature check succeeds.
_approve writes _allowedValue[owner][spender].
sendValue performs a low-level call forwarding ETH to a caller-influenced recipient, enabling reentrancy.
functionCallWithValue performs a low-level value-bearing call to an arbitrary target.
functionDelegateCall executes arbitrary target code via delegatecall in this storage context.
newOwner_ parameter is validated and stored as the pending owner.
pushManagement writes _newOwner.
pushManagement is restricted to the manager via msg.sender.
_owner is the authorization reference for pushManagement.

normalization_plan.reason: Function parameter only exists to bind the staking contract inside initialize; fold into that core function node.
Parameter is consumed exclusively by the setIndex core function.
Profit input drives only the rebase arithmetic and should collapse into rebase.
Epoch input is used only inside rebase for accounting and events.
Snapshot parameter is used only in the _storeRebase percent computation.
Profit is consumed only by _storeRebase for percent and amountRebased.
Epoch is stored only by the _storeRebase core function.
Address parameter is only a lookup key in balanceOf.
Amount parameter is used only by gonsForBalance conversion.
Gon parameter is used only by balanceForGons conversion.
Recipient parameter belongs solely to the transfer core function.
Value parameter exists only inside transfer.
Sender parameter is only consumed by transferFrom.
Recipient parameter is only consumed by transferFrom.
Value parameter exists only inside transferFrom.
Spender parameter is only used by the approve core function.
Allowance value parameter is only written by approve.
Spender parameter is scoped to increaseAllowance.
Added value parameter is only used in the increaseAllowance arithmetic.
Spender parameter is scoped to decreaseAllowance.
Subtracted value parameter is only used in the decreaseAllowance arithmetic.
Owner parameter is only used for the permit signature check.
Spender parameter is only used inside permit.
Amount parameter is only used inside permit.
Deadline parameter is only compared inside permit.
Signature component is only forwarded to ecrecover from permit.
Signature component is only forwarded to ecrecover from permit.
Signature component is only forwarded to ecrecover from permit.
Candidate owner parameter is only validated and staged by pushManagement.
Local gon amount is a temporary inside transfer and should merge into that function.
Local rebase amount is a temporary used only inside rebase.
Cached supply local is a temporary scoped to rebase.
Cached allowance local is a temporary scoped to decreaseAllowance.
Recovered signer local is a temporary inside permit.
Struct hash local is a temporary inside permit.
